Claim 1 (Currently Amended): A method of cementing comprising: providing a cement composition comprising a __modified__ carboxylated inulin; and allowing the cement composition to set.

Claim 11 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 1 wherein the cement composition is placed in a subterranean formation __in the presence of a specific retarder agent__.

Claim 12 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 1 wherein the cement composition is placed in a wellbore __with a defined composition of additives__. 

Claim 13 (Currently Amended): A method of cementing in a subterranean formation comprising: providing a cement composition comprising a __modified__ carboxylated inulin; placing the cement composition in the subterranean formation; and allowing the cement composition to set therein.
